finite_H27_families.prior_art: Irrep inventory is already proved in the repo (2026-09-22 address/operator H27 intertwiner). This PASS checks it independently and connects it to geometric obstructions.
finite_H27_families.caveat: A nontrivial H27 central character plus irreducibility implies rank3, but neither H27 dynamics nor physical irreducibility nor a choice between the two conjugate center characters is derived.

spherical_space_form_no_go.theorem: Finite groups acting freely on spheres have periodic group cohomology and all abelian subgroups cyclic. H27 contains C3xC3.
spherical_space_form_no_go.physical_scope: No smooth spherical space form S7/H27 with free deck action; NOT a no-go for H27 as gauge holonomy on a defect complement, finite quotient of pi1 on a DIFFERENT positive-Einstein manifold, or an orbifold with fixed points.

smooth_nearlyG2_flat_Dirac_no_go.assumption: smooth closed spin nearly parallel G2, tau0 nonzero; ordinary geometric Dirac with a unitary FLAT Hermitian gauge bundle
smooth_nearlyG2_flat_Dirac_no_go.nonflat_gauge_curvature_Clifford_endomor: operator norm K >= 21*tau0^2/32 somewhere for zero modes; otherwise Weitzenbock form remains strictly positive
smooth_nearlyG2_flat_Dirac_no_go.caveat: No-go is for smooth closed positive-scalar geometry, ordinary gauge-Dirac with FLAT unitary twist and no boundary/singular contribution. Does not apply to charged 7D ADE defects, torsion/flux-modified supercovariant operators, nonflat curvature or spinors with physical boundary projectors.

E8_parallel_Higgs_and_family_multiplicit.reason: Any global parallel adjoint VEV lives in the holonomy centralizer h. The center z(h)=u1^3 commutes with EVERY VEV in h, even several noncommuting ones.
E8_parallel_Higgs_and_family_multiplicit.non_double_count_option: Use the 3D spatial zero-mode space itself as the H27 triplet, or add non-Abelian mixing that removes unwanted degeneracy; cannot multiply two independently supplied triplets and still call result 3.
E8_parallel_Higgs_and_family_multiplicit.physics_limit: This does NOT prohibit nonparallel/charged Higgs sections, a nonflat gauge profile, source-localized Higgs, nonlinear index coupling or nontrivial global family-bundle gluing. The PW scalar kernel and H27 fiber were only tensored in a conditional product ansatz.
